mentions.name: Zero-Config Cloud Hosting Platform
mentions.description: This platform is a zero-config cloud hosting service positioned as an alternative to Vercel and Render. It lets users connect their GitHub and deploy from web, CLI, VS Code, or Cursor, auto-detects static sites and serves them from a CDN, and includes logging, encrypted environment variables, built-in monitoring, custom domains, automatic deployments from new branches or commits, and multi-branch deployments.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm taking on Vercel and Render with a zero config cloud hosting platform.
